skill.displayName: 收入与成本截止性核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: This is a local Chinese-language accounting cutoff-check skill that reads user-supplied working-paper text and produces deterministic findings without network use or persistence.

dimensions.detail: Allowed tools Read and Bash are proportionate for running a local Node script against a user-supplied file; searches found no network clients, child-process execution, credential access, environment-variable use, or file writes.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install-time hooks, package installation steps, remote downloads, or external dependencies were found; the scripts use Node.js standard library modules only.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The invocation phrases include a natural-language complaint and the user-facing text is mainly Chinese, but that matches the accounting workflow presented by the artifact and does not create hidden authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact shows no persistence, background workers, scheduled tasks, memory writes, privilege escalation, or changes to agent behavior beyond the active skill instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, runtime code, sample template, and outputs align around checking revenue and cost cutoff working papers for arithmetic, date-period consistency, duplicate document numbers, blanks, and common document-type issues.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using a Chinese-language local tool for audit or month-end cutoff working papers. Review results as advisory checks, not audit opinions, and be aware that duplicate-document findings may be repeated because the duplicate check runs twice.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced script was present and inspected; it loads the local engine and reads only the explicit input file or built-in sample.
[SQP-1] expected: The broader trigger phrase is a scoping quality issue, but it remains tied to cutoff working-paper mismatches and does not add sensitive or hidden behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-only user-facing text is consistent with the skill name, examples, and target accounting workflow; users needing another language should be aware of that limitation.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The duplicate-document check is invoked twice, which can duplicate findings for repeated document numbers; this is a correctness bug rather than a security or privilege concern.
